It is completely understandable to be concerned about how this recent car accident might affect you. Yes, experiencing a new traumatic or highly stressful event can sometimes add to or complicate existing PTSD. When your nervous system is already sensitized from your military experiences, a sudden shock like a car accident can trigger familiar stress responses, heighten anxiety, or bring up new challenges. 

Please know that you do not have to navigate this compounding stress alone. It would be very beneficial to share this recent accident and any new or worsening symptoms with a healthcare provider or mental health professional. They can help you understand how these two experiences might be interacting and work with you to adjust your support plan so you can continue healing.
